messages:
sam: @channel Heads-up: Aurora Health (account: aurora-acct-513) reporting widespread 502/504s and timeouts on their dedicated cluster (us-west-2) starting ~08:12 UTC. CSM flagged. Paging SRE on-call immediately.

oncall-bot: Incident logged: INC-2000101111 - aurora-dedicated-usw2-degraded. Pages sent to @rohit (primary), @maria (secondary). Severity: SEV2.

rohit: Im taking triage. First glance: model-serving pods on gpu-node-7 restarting; proxy spike in 502s. Anyone see recent deploys or config changes to that cluster? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: No deploys targeted to dedicated-cluster-aurora-01 in last 2h. Last infra change: autoscaler policy tweak at 05:30 UTC.

ellen: Customer (CSM Alice Choi) already emailed support/legal asking for impact details. We need a short impact note + ETA to pass to CSM. Sam, confirm contact list so we route notices correctly.

sam: Aurora contact routing: Primary CSM: alice.choi@aurora-health.com; Ops: dev-ops@aurora-health.com; Security: sec-ops@aurora-health.com; Pager: +1-555-0142. Escalate to AE if outage >2h.

rohit: Quick triage logs: proxy -> model-serv-03 shows repeated connection resets; model-worker processes OOMKilled around 08:10 UTC. KV cache hitrate collapsed (78% -> 22%) coincident with restarts.

rohit: Running checks:
```
kubectl -n dedicated-aurora logs model-serv-03 --since=15m | tail -n 200
kubectl -n dedicated-aurora describe node gpu-node-7
```
Results: multiple oom_killer entries, cgroup mem pressure, repeated model-worker restarts.

maria: If the node is flapping, we should divert Aurora traffic to a hosted fallback variant while we replace the node. Propose a 30-60m targeted redirect.

rohit: Agreed. Mitigation plan:
1) Apply routing override for aurora-acct-513 -> hosted-fallback-lowlat (targeted, expires 30m).
2) Drain + replace gpu-node-7; inspect kernel OOM logs.
3) Temporarily increase autoscaler min +2.
4) Monitor error rates; rollback override when errors <1% for 5m.

sam: Draft customer impact blurb (for CSM/email):
"Aurora Health may experience intermittent failures (502/504) and elevated latency on your dedicated cluster in US-WEST-2 due to a GPU node instability. Were routing traffic to a hosted fallback to maintain availability. Expected mitigation window: approximately 30\t60 minutes. No customer data exposure detected. We will update you within 20 minutes or sooner. - Redwood Inference SRE & Support"

ellen: Add explicit compliance line: "We have seen only resource failures; no model weights or customer data were exposed." Then send.

rohit: Applying routing override now:
```
redwood ctl route override --account aurora-acct-513 --to hosted-fallback-lowlat --expires 00:30:00 --note "emergency redirect due to node OOMs"
```

oncall-bot: Routing override applied by rohit at 08:20:12 UTC. Traffic shifting.

support-bot: Metrics update: error rate for aurora-acct-513 dropped from 12.7% -> 2.3% within 3 minutes post-override. p50/p95 latency: 115ms / 710ms.

rohit: Draining gpu-node-7; collecting dmesg and journalctl for oom_killer traces:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
sudo journalctl -k | grep -i oom
```
Kernel logs show repeated oom_killer targeting model-worker PID. Likely memory leak or an outlier workload.

maria: Autoscaler min increased by +2 for cluster; new nodes provisioning (ETA ~6m).

sam: Status page short update (for public/internal):
"INC-2000101111: Aurora Health dedicated cluster (us-west-2) experienced degraded availability due to a GPU node resource failure. Traffic temporarily routed to hosted fallback while node is replaced. Error rates decreasing; mitigation in progress. Updated 08:28 UTC."

ellen: Drafting customer email to Alice + ops. Short, clear, includes compliance line and next update ETA. Will post copy to account thread for transparency.

rohit: Node replacement completed; node rejoined cluster, model workers restarting cleanly. K/V cache warming initiated. Monitoring post-recovery metrics.

support-bot: Current metrics: error rate 0.9%, p95 latency 380ms, p50 98ms. KV cache hitrate recovering to 55%.

maria: Initiating controlled failback: shift 20% traffic back to dedicated cluster for 10m validation window.

oncall-bot: Handoff note: @rohit staying for failback validation. If stable by 09:00 UTC handoff to @maria for overnight coverage. Keep channel updated.

rohit: Failback looks stable - errors remain <1%. Proceeding to restore full traffic.

deploy-bot: Routing override removed by rohit at 08:52:03 UTC.

ellen: Sent customer email and posted copy to account thread; CSM looped in AEs.

sam: Final internal summary for ticket:
- Root cause: GPU node memory pressure -> repeated OOMKills causing model-worker restarts.
- Mitigations: targeted routing override to hosted fallback; replaced faulty node; autoscaler min bump.
- Customer impact: intermittent 502/504s and higher latency for ~40 minutes; no data exposure.
- Follow-ups: postmortem to include kernel tuning, autoscaler threshold review, and improved early OOM alerts.

maria: Im taking overnight oncall. Handoff docs and playbook steps attached to incident ticket. Monitoring for next 2h.

sam: Closing channel for now  excellent coordination everyone. :tada:
